author: Ricosnico
quote: The fact that a character from almost 20 years ago makes a cameo, and aura farms your two protagonists in 3 minutes of screen time speaks volumes. Rockstar has lost the plot. Do yourself a favor and don’t buy this game. By far one of the worst written GTA games ever. Also, the fact this is considered equivalent to Ocarina of Time is a plain insult. The gaming industry is now just a cash farm, and this is the living proof. Hope the new wave of Rockstar gets layed off, and makes some more slop at another studio, just them to get layed off again, because they are absolutely dog water developers.
